column1: # Game profile of Batman: Arkham Asylum (Switch, update 1.0.1 = v65536). Plays on the Mac
# Format: see dm/games/README.md; bring-up and measurements in README.md beside this file
# Rocksteady's Unreal Engine 3 (package version 864, Oodle Leviathan chunks) with Scaleform menus and Bink movies, SDK 14.3.0, NVN.
# The shaders store no control section: each is a descriptor record whose 0x50-byte tail the engine's loader turns into one, and a record whose tail names a second module
# holds a two-module vertex program inline (shader_split.py aa_records / aa_ctl / aa_code; README.md, Files and shaders)
# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID
# main sets a heap of at most the pool - 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource (IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false)
# Unreal Engine 3 fills its texture pools from the CPU and never flushes them (README.md, What it needs: 234,144 writes beside a texture against 485 re-uploads).
# tex_dirty_upload needs tex_flush_upload on. Both default off, and a provisional profile never guessed them.
